items.title: Anthropic commits shares to a new Public Benefit Fund
items.summary: Anthropic announced on October 18 that it will commit 5% of its shares (subject to stockholder approval) to a new, wholly-owned Public Benefit Fund LLC, with the stake growing by 2% for every 50% rise in company valuation. The Fund builds on the founders' earlier pledge of 80% of their own equity and brings total committed shares to roughly 20%; Anthropic cites addressing AI's labor-market impact as an example use.
items.whyItMatters: Not a product change, but a signal of how a frontier lab competing with OpenAI and Google on the LLM/voice stack Romain and Anna depend on is structuring its long-term capital and priorities.
